S_AddRange:
	for (.@range_id = getarg(0); .@range_id <= getarg(1); ++.@range_id)
		callsub S_AddStone,.@range_id,getarg(2)+.@range_id-getarg(0),getarg(3,-1),getarg(4,0);
	return;
S_AddStone:
	.@row = getarraysize(.StoneId);
	.@group = getarg(2,-1);
	.@display$ = getitemname(getarg(0));
	if (.@group < 0) {
		if (strpos(.@display$,"Upper") >= 0) .@group = 0;
		else if (strpos(.@display$,"Middle") >= 0) .@group = 1;
		else if (strpos(.@display$,"Lower") >= 0 || strpos(.@display$,"Bottom") >= 0) .@group = 2;
		else if (strpos(.@display$,"Dual") >= 0) .@group = 4;
		else .@group = 3;
	}
	.StoneId[.@row] = getarg(0);
	.EnchantId[.@row] = getarg(1);
	.Group[.@row] = .@group;
	.Service[.@row] = (.@group < 3 || .@group == 6) ? 0 : (.@group < 5 ? 1 : 2);
	.Slot[.@row] = .@group < 3 ? .@group : (.@group == 5 ? 3 : (.@group == 4 || .@group == 6 ? 1 : 0));
	.Mask[.@row] = getarg(3,0);
	if (!.Mask[.@row]) .Mask[.@row] = .@group < 3 ? 1 << .@group : 8;
	return;
}
